rules.name: Agile
rules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Cyber-Eyes
rules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model gets +1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Deadly
rules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

rules.name: Decimate
rules.description: When attacking units with more than half of their total size or Tough value (for single-model units), the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Enhanced Cyber-Eyes
rules.description: If this model has Cyber-Eyes, it always gets +1 to hit rolls from Cyber-Eyes (instead of only when shooting over 9" away).

rules.name: Enhanced Cyber-Eyes Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Cyber-Eyes. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Enhanced Precision Marksman
rules.description: If this model has Precision Marksman, it always gets +1 to hit rolls from Precision Marksman (instead of only when shooting over 9" away).

rules.name: Fortified
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

rules.name: Fortified Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fortified. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Increased Shooting Range Mark
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +6" range on their weapons when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Precision Marksman
rules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model gets +1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Ranged Slayer
rules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Ranged Slayer Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ranged Slayer. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Rapid Advance
rules.description: This model moves +4" when using Advance actions.

rules.name: Rapid Advance Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Rapid Advance. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Repel Ambushers
rules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

rules.name: Shred
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

rules.name: Slayer
rules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Steadfast
rules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

rules.name: Takedown
rules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

rules.name: Takedown Shot
rules.description: Once per game, when this model shoots, it may make X extra attacks against the target at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Unstoppable in Melee Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Versatile Reach
rules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, all models with this rule in this unit either get +4" range when shooting or move +2" when charging.

rules.name: Versatile Reach Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Reach. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

spells.name: Corpo-Network Link
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Cyber-Eyes once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Cyberspace Vision
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +6" range on their weapons when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: EMP Blast
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with Shred.

spells.name: Neurotoxin Cloud
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each.

spells.name: Overload Electronics
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 3 hits with Decimate.

spells.name: Stimulant Shock
spells.effect: Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Steadfast once (next time the effect would apply).
